exposure: admission to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 2,929 children born in Slovenia in 2008, whose perinatal data was linked to their physical fitness and BMI results at eight years of age.
finding: Higher maternal education and lower maternal pre-pregnancy BMI were identified as the most significant determinants of a child's BMI and physical fitness at school-age, with physical fitness also inversely associated with nulliparity and NICU admission.
